info.title: agent-api-sdk extraction and review API
info.description: Document extraction with human review. Every error body has the Error shape. Test auth: Bearer tokens of seeded test users (see README). Responses are validated against these schemas by the server before they are sent.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same key and body returns the existing job (200, created false). Same key, other body: 409. Keys are scoped per user.

200.description: replay of the same key and body

400.description: INVALID_INPUT with issues, INVALID_JSON or MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY

get.summary: Get a job with steps, document text and review

404.description: unknown job, or a job of another user (JOB_NOT_FOUND); the two are indistinguishable

201.description: correction stored; the model proposal is unchanged

400.description: INVALID_INPUT: unknown field, wrong type, quote not in the document, null without reason

404.description: unknown job, or a job of another user (JOB_NOT_FOUND); the two are indistinguishable

post.summary: Write and return the approved local draft

200.description: draft written under the server data directory

404.description: unknown job, or a job of another user (JOB_NOT_FOUND); the two are indistinguishable

409.description: NOT_APPROVED (never approved, or corrected after the last approval) or JOB_NOT_READY
